lines.text: No Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly, because they hired Balaam to curse Israel, but the LORD turned the curse into a blessing.
Israel must not despise an Edomite, for he is their brother, and his third generation of children may enter the assembly.
An unclean man must leave the camp, wash with water at evening, and return after seven days.
Israel must not charge a brother interest, but may charge a Levite interest, so the LORD may bless them.
In a neighbor's vineyard you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not put any in your basket.
